 Dated this the 1st day of August, 2014.
 J U D G M E N T

This writ petition is filed by the petitioner for a direction to respondents 1 to 3 to establish an analysis mechanism consistent with international standards for the consignments which are meant for importing to India.

2. The case of the petitioner is that the consignment imported by him has already been re- imported on account of non compliance with the standards mentioned in Food Safety and Standard Act,
2006.
Petitioner wants for a pre-import sample analysis in respect of the future consignment to be imported.
The Standing Counsel submits that there is no such provision as per the request made by the petitioner.
Having regard to the fact that the matter is pending before the sixth respondent, I am of the view the said respondent shall consider such case, if possible, to be entertained.

If the WP(C).No.9804/2014-A. petitioner approaches the sixth respondent with a copy of this judgment, a decision shall be taken by the said respondent after affording an opportunity to the petitioner,
within a period of two months.
The writ petition is disposed of as above.

Sd/-
A.MUHAMED MUSTAQUE, (Judge) Kvs/-
